world.title: Iran's president tells Trump it will never 'bend the knee'
world.description: Masoud Pezeshkian's defiant speech to the UN comes after the US president threatened to "annihilate" Iran if a peace deal is not agreed soon.

world.title: Ethiopia and Tigray accuse each of launching offensives, fuelling fears of new war
world.description: The local authorities reportedly seize Tigray's airports following reports of recent drone strikes.

world.title: Trump's Board of Peace unveils $2.45bn plan to begin Gaza's reconstruction
world.description: The figure was announced during a meeting of the group's board at the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York.

world.title: White House rolling out red carpet for historic Xi Jinping visit
world.description: Trump and Xi are expected to discuss a range of issues from trade to AI during the latter's multi-day visit to Washington.

world.title: Dramatic eviction of woman aged 87 highlights Spain's housing shortage
world.description: The tenant of the flat in Madrid, Maricarmen, was unable to pay the rent set by the firm which recently bought it.

world.title: Dolly Parton's manager accuses her nephew of 'threats and intimidation'
world.description: Bryan Seaver, who announced Parton's death to the world, is accused of trying to extort her estate.

world.title: Harvey Weinstein sentenced to 15 years in prison for sexual assault
world.description: Assault survivor Miriam Haley said the "devastating effect on my life and sense of security that may never go away".

world.title: Poland accuses Russian military helicopter of violating its airspace
world.description: Poland says the aircraft stayed in its skies for 42 seconds, forcing the Nato member to scramble its fighter jets.

world.title: Reports of violence against women in Gaza surge, UN agency finds
world.description: The UN Population Fund also says there has been a "severe escalation" in the number of early and forced marriages.

world.title: Eleven killed in mass shooting at house in South Africa
world.description: One of those killed is believed to be a pregnant woman, police said.

world.title: Trump administration accuses banned media outlets of 'falsehoods' ahead of court hearing
world.description: The US Justice Department's response to a lawsuit filed by CNN, Politico and MS NOW also cites national security.

world.title: Azerbaijan pardons Frenchman after EU lifts sanctions on Russian billionaire
world.description: Martin Ryan is pardoned months after he was jailed on charges of spying, but a second Frenchman remains in prison.

world.title: Trump meets US-backed Venezuelan president for first time since Maduro seized
world.description: Rodriguez was handpicked by Trump as leader of Venezuela was arrested and taken to the US

world.title: South Sudan's president dissolves government ahead of country's first elections
world.description: South Sudan has not held elections since independence in 2011 - polls have twice been postponed.

world.title: Hurricane Polo downgraded but remains 'very powerful' off coast of Mexico
world.description: The large storm in the Pacific Ocean is being driven by warm waters caused by the El Niño weather phenomenon.

US.title: Trump set to greet Xi for high-stakes state visit
US.description: It is the second time the leaders are meeting this year after the Beijing summit in May.

US.title: Iran's president gives a rare wartime speech at the U.N.
US.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian addressed the U.N. General Assembly a day after President Trump threatened from the same podium to "annihilate" Iran.

US.title: A Catholic media star will be beatified in St. Louis, moving a step closer to sainthood
US.description: Bishop Fulton Sheen, who charmed millions of television viewers on his show L<em>ife Is Worth Living,'</em>will come one step closer to being declared a saint.

US.title: From cybersecurity to AI to Taiwan, what's at stake in Trump's summit with Xi
US.description: As President Trump and China's President Xi prepare to meet, Rush Doshi of the Council on Foreign Relations explains the current state of U.S.-China relations and what to expect from this summit.

US.title: It's getting harder to afford rent in the U.S., even for middle-income families
US.description: Housing affordability challenges are spreading to higher income brackets, according to new research, which found one in five renters struggled last year to pay for their housing in full and on time.

US.title: Greetings from Edinburgh, where a cheeky tour guide makes art history hilarious
US.description: For anyone who grew up staring blankly at museum artwork, this is the fun that was missing: Coco leads interactive and (mostly) factual art history comedy tours.

US.title: Is Nepal's flood a harbinger of what's to come in the Himalayas?
US.description: Building dams and hydropower plants in the Himalayas holds great promise for providing electricity. In the wake of the Nepal disaster, experts are asking about the risks of such construction.

US.title: Dems have an edge over GOP, poll finds. And, ICE looks into 'mobile detention centers'
US.description: An NPR poll shows that Democrats have an edge over Republicans going into the midterms, partially due to Trump. And, Immigration and Customs Enforcement is looking into "mobile detention centers.

US.title: U.N. Ambassador Mike Waltz on Iran, Venezuela and Trump's foreign policy
US.description: Deals, threats and oil are all on the table as the president's foreign policy takes center stage.

US.title: Will FDA advisers recommend a multi-cancer blood test for approval? They'll vote
US.description: The company Grail says its Galleri blood test can detect up to 50 forms of cancer. An independent panel of experts will decide if the test should be recommended for FDA approval.
